Name: Cozy Chocolate Kitchen
Author: skellady
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/qzbLTOn.png[/img]﻿[/center]



[img]https://imgur.com/Jl1E0ek.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]This mod retextures the kitchen to match the theme of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20011]Cozy Chocolate Furniture[/url] mod. You can choose between the Chocolate or White Chocolate options in the config! You [b]CAN[/b] use this without the furniture pack, which is why it's a separate mod. You aren't obligated to use them together.

[size=3]Farmhouse used in the screenshot is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16438]Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse[/url]﻿.[/size]

[/size][img]https://imgur.com/cmP0vay.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Install this mod.
3. Extract all and drop them into your Mods folder.[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/OYwortt.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]- [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/about-me]Airyn[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MsHakunaMatata/about-me]HakunaMatata[/url] for helping out with the mod name.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Fixed kitchen not loading when used alongside DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors. Thank you Pavlus for testing!
